facts.fact: Ezulwini Town Council's annual report for the year to March 2024 says the Council adopted voice-over-IP to restore the five telephone lines to its office, carrying the voice traffic over the office's internet line, and installed a new PABX linking its two office buildings.
facts.system: Ezulwini Town Council office internet line

facts.fact: Ezulwini Town Council reports that in the year to March 2024 it migrated to Microsoft Office 365 for the office's business email and productivity tools, bought and installed virtual conferencing equipment for online meetings, and ran its telephone lines over the internet line.
facts.system: Ezulwini Town Council office internet line

facts.fact: One urban local authority, Ezulwini Town Council, reports on its own office's internet line in its annual report for the year to March 2024; the report gives no figure for other local authorities.
facts.system: Ezulwini Town Council office internet line

facts.fact: Ezulwini Town Council's annual report for the year to March 2024 says its Corporate Services Department, through the Council's own IT section, provides IT services and infrastructure to the municipality and carried out the year's ICT works itself.
facts.system: Ezulwini Town Council office internet line

facts.fact: Ezulwini Town Council's audited accounts for the year to March 2024 carry its ICT costs in the Council's own operating expenses: information management systems E618,817 (E602,206 the year before), telephone and fax E222,899 and computer maintenance and accessories E82,828; the accounts do not separate the internet line.
